# Remixed music

These project-supplied recordings are alternate arrangements of the
opening/title, menu/selection, victory and game-over music. They are distributed
separately from the GPL-licensed reconstruction source code. Inclusion here does
not alter the rights in the underlying original compositions.

The root files retain the December 1990 timing profile. `ms91-v2/` contains
the same project's actual Suno recordings with February 1991 timing, loop and
transition preparation, plus checksum provenance. These files are used only
for Updated music; Original music uses its separate game implementations.
